concerns.location: plan.md:FR/SC Coverage Matrix, rows FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005
concerns.text: Plan claims FR-002 through FR-005 are 'Covered' by code modules (preprocess.py, connectivity.py, centrality.py, pli.py), but the Comments Block explicitly states: T002 unit tests fail due to real bugs (mne.time_frequency.psd_welch doesn't exist, spike[::sfreq] uses float slice, missing paths import); T003 code/metrics.py is a 1.3 KB stub with no implementations; no actual data files exist (epochs_*.npz, connectivity_*.npy, pli_*.npy). These FRs are NOT actually covered by working code.

Plan states T001 downloads dataset and T002 preprocesses it, but Comments Block reports T001 exit=1 (download failed) and T002 has no output files (data/processed/epochs_*.npz, metadata_*.json, validation_log.txt do not exist). The foundational data pipeline has not been executed.

Plan claims T006 aggregates results into SubjectMetrics.csv, but Comments Block states the CSV is 'fabricated placeholder data with the wrong columns' (has subject_id,centrality,pli,global_coherence instead of schema's stage_label, mean_pli, n_epochs, ...). This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) — the aggregated metrics file does not derive from real processed data.

Plan claims T008 computes global VIF and outputs vif_report.json, but Comments Block states 'vif_report.json is missing' and no connectivity_*_*.npy files exist. VIF cannot be computed without the underlying connectivity matrices.

Data model defines SubjectMetrics with columns including stage_label, mean_pli, n_epochs, centrality_degree_mean, etc., but the actual data/metrics/SubjectMetrics.csv in the repository has wrong columns (subject_id,centrality,pli,global_coherence). Plan and data-model do not agree on the actual schema being produced.

concerns.location: plan.md:Computational Feasibility & Methodological Rigor, CPU-First Design section
concerns.text: Plan describes subject-by-subject streaming and intermediate file outputs (epochs_*.npz, connectivity_*.npy, centrality_*.json, pli_*.npy), but Comments Block confirms none of these files exist. The plan's computational strategy cannot be validated because the pipeline has not been executed.

Plan claims T015 runs integration test on 3-subject subset and validates SubjectMetrics.csv and analysis_results.json, but no evidence of this test execution exists. The Comments Block does not mention any successful integration test run.

Plan lists 'All unit tests pass' and 'Integration test passes' as success metrics, but Comments Block explicitly states T002 unit tests fail (exit 1) and T003 tests fail at import (exit 2). These success criteria are not met.

Research doc claims PhysioNet Sleep-EDF dataset is verified and contains required electrodes/sleep stages, but plan.md and Comments Block show the download (T001) failed (exit=1). The dataset has not been successfully acquired, so the 'Fit Verification' claim cannot be substantiated.

Plan claims FR-013 (validate SubjectMetrics.csv against schema) is covered by validate.py, but the actual SubjectMetrics.csv has wrong columns and no validation_log.txt exists. This FR is not actually implemented or executed.

concerns.location: plan.md:Computational Feasibility & Methodological Rigor, Dataset Fit & Feasibility section
concerns.text: Plan states 'After filtering, we validate N ≥ 30 subjects' and 'if fewer remain, the pipeline aborts with an explicit warning.' However, no filtering has been performed (no preprocessed data exists), so the claim that the dataset 'fits' the methodology cannot be verified. The plan assumes the dataset will yield ≥30 subjects with ≥2 min wake, but this has not been tested.

Plan claims '✓ I. Reproducibility – All steps are scripted, random seeds pinned in code/config.yaml, and dataset fetched from a fixed verified URL with checksum validation (FR-001).' However, the download failed (T001 exit=1) and no code/config.yaml is mentioned in the actual code structure. This claim is premature.

Quickstart provides step-by-step instructions (python code/download.py, python code/main.py --stage preprocess, etc.), but these scripts either do not exist (download.py, main.py with --stage flags) or are stubs (metrics.py). The quickstart cannot be followed as written.

Plan lists code/main.py as the orchestration script with --stage flags (preprocess, connectivity, centrality, pli, aggregate, vif, analysis, report), but Comments Block indicates code/metrics.py is a 1.3 KB stub and no main.py with this interface is described. The actual code structure does not match the plan.

Both schema files are defined in the plan, but the actual SubjectMetrics.csv does not conform to dataset.schema.yaml (wrong columns). The contracts are aspirational but not validated against real outputs.
